text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... This was way beyond the margin of
error...
and not in a good way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Fine! I'll just rewrite the whole damn
program
from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't need a lecture, thank you.
choice_data_list: Don't rush, let's take it steady.
Let's work together to improve it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...That said, you're not wrong. I'm not
gonna write
any good code while I'm this
stressed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Let's get back right away. I'll cool my
head for a
minute and then take a look
at the program.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're so annoying that you've looped
around
into being hilarious. You plannin'
on helping me
debug?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I take it back—you're not funny at all. So
you
don't have any concrete solutions?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Fine. If you believe in me so much, that
means
you'll stay outta my way, right?
Sit tight and
watch while I figure it out
myself.
